description: This file implements the UI for the 'Topic' screen in an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It includes composable functions for rendering the topic header, list of news resources, toolbar, and handles different UI states like loading and success. The file also contains preview functions for design-time visualization.

classes.name: TopicUiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing the UI state of the topic, with loading, error, and success variants containing relevant data.

classes.name: NewsUiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing the UI state of news resources, with loading, error, and success variants containing lists of news.

classes.name: FollowableTopic
classes.description: Data class representing a topic that can be followed, includes follow status and topic details.

classes.name: UserNewsResource
classes.description: Data class representing a news resource associated with user interactions.

methods.name: TopicScreen
methods.description: Main composable function displaying the topic screen, managing UI state and scrollbars.

methods.name: TopicBodyPreview
methods.description: Preview composable demonstrating the topic body with mock data.

methods.name: TopicHeader
methods.description: Displays the topic image, name, and description.

methods.name: userNewsResourceCards
methods.description: Displays news resource cards or loading/error states within the topic screen.

methods.name: TopicToolbar
methods.description: Toolbar with back button and follow toggle for the topic.

methods.name: topicItemsSize
methods.description: Calculates total items for scrollbar based on UI state.

methods.name: TopicScreenPopulated
methods.description: Previews the topic screen with populated data.

methods.name: TopicScreenLoading
methods.description: Previews the loading state of the topic screen.
